# advisory-lock-serializes-and-blocks-compiles

The runner acquires a per-repository PostgreSQL advisory lock for the entire run; long-running compiles will block other compile attempts for the same repo until the lock is released, which may cause queuing or timeouts.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._locked_session`
